title: Lab reflections — standup digest (Jul 5 2028)
content:
TL;DR:
Weekly synthesis of applied-ml standups and lab notes focusing on quantization probes, eval drift discoveries, and model-onboarding readiness. Mostly experimental week: calibration work, a small canary for a 4-bit quant variant, and several flaky infra failures (OOMs) in the local test harness.

Meeting context and attendees:
- Meeting: Applied ML weekly research standup / lab sync
- Date: 2028-07-05 10:30am PT
- Attendees: Asha, Miguel, Priya, Evan, Leah, (notes to self: capture action items inline)

Highlights this week:
1) Quant probe: ran int8 and q4f16-style quant on rwd-7b-v2 (internal name rwd7b-v2). Calibration set expanded from 2k->8k tokens (diverse prompts). Observations: int8 OPs stable but memory footprint still high when KV cache warm. q4 variant drops BLEU-style rerank accuracy by ~2.8% absolute on our internal pairwise eval; human eval spot-check shows mild coherence issues on long-context generation (>=1024 tokens).
2) Eval findings: regression surfaced in the ranking eval for product-summarization (JIRA: JIRA-INF-4921). The regression correlates with tokenization differences in the onboarding pipeline (tokenizer v1 vs v2) — mapping mismatch caused different chunk boundaries leading to scoring differences.
3) Onboarding: model artifact layout for private deploy validated. Packaging PR created (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve-runtime/pull/1874). Canary plan drafted: 5% traffic to q4-candidate, fallback to int8 baseline for latency > 400ms.

Experiments run (short notes / quick results):
- EXP-quant-042: rwd7b-v2 int8 with 8k calibration, dynamic KV prefetch enabled -> latency +6% vs baseline, token cost -18%, eval delta (pairwise) -0.6%.
- EXP-quant-043: rwd7b-v2 q4 (fused matmul kernels) -> latency -12% vs int8 baseline on p4d, but rerank accuracy -2.8% and some hallucination patterns on long lists.
- EXP-eval-311: rerun ranking eval with consistent tokenizer v2 pipeline -> regression disappears (indicates tokenizer mismatch as root cause).
- EXP-kv-079: microbatch size sweep 1/2/4/8 -> microbatch 2 hits best latency/cost sweet spot for mixed small/med sized requests.

Problems / blockers:
- Local test harness OOM when running q4 workloads with sequence length 2k and batch 4. Root cause likely mismatch in allocator flags when using fused kernels + prefetched KV. Repro steps in linear ticket LP-1123.
- Some flaky test failures in infra CI (flaky seed in sampling tests). Need to pin RNG in test harness for deterministic comparisons.
- Pending legal review for private deployment packaging (customer export concern) — blocking on compliance checklist in Confluence entry CONFL-2382.

Notes / informal observations (brainstorm-y):
- q4 seems promising for cost but requires a small-model-specific calibration dataset that mirrors long-form contexts; current calibration uses mostly short prompts which probably explains hallucination drift. TODO: assemble 4–6 long-context calibration prompts from customer logs (anonymized).
- Consider a hybrid runtime that uses int8 for prefix processing and q4 for decoder-only tokengen to minimize KV overhead (sketch idea, needs perf modeling).
- Keep an eye on layernorm folding and bfloat16 emisssions in kernel code path — a change last sprint might have subtle numerical effects on q4.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Asha: add long-context calibration set draft to CONFL-2382 and attach sample prompts (due 2028-07-08).
- Miguel: debug OOM in local harness, post minimal repro and allocator flags to LP-1123 (due 2028-07-06).
- Priya: run extended human eval on q4 candidate focusing on summarization and bullet-list outputs; sample size 200 (due 2028-07-12).
- Evan: patch onboarding PR to include tokenizer v2 migration scripts and CI smoke test; link PR -> JIRA-INF-4921 (due 2028-07-07).
- Leah: scope canary dashboard (latency, rerank-accuracy, fallback rate) and wire up alerts for >2% rerank regression (due 2028-07-09).

Follow-ups for next week:
- Canary: start a controlled 1% traffic canary for q4 candidate behind a feature flag and run isolated load for 48h; collect latency tails and quality metrics.
- Ablation: test impact of layernorm folding off vs on for q4 on a 100-sample eval set.
- Infra: add deterministic RNG seeding to sampling tests to reduce CI flakes.

Unresolved questions / decisions needed:
- Threshold for automatic rollback on quality regression — propose conservative 1.5% rerank loss at 5% traffic, but need product signoff (ask product-hosted-api).
- Do we accept a small human-perf penalty for 25–35% cost reduction? ROI calc required; finance wants unit-cost delta and projected monthly savings for Dedicated customers.

Misc scratchpad / notes-to-self:
- Link for quick reference: CONFL-2382 (onboard checklist), PR-1874 (serve-runtime packaging), LP-1123 (local harness repro).
- Quick command to repro OOM locally: (not exact) ./run_local_harness --model rwd7b-v2 --quant q4 --seq 2048 --batch 4 --allocator=tcmalloc (capture stdout/stderr).
- Meeting note: sync with product-hosted-api next Tue to align rollback thresholds.

End of digest. Save a snapshot of eval results to the team S3 bucket after the canary completes (notes for Priya).

-- Asha (raw lab notes, intentionally terse in places)
